verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI is fundamentally API/CLI-first (arun, crwl CLI, Docker+FastAPI server) and includes an interactive playground that 'test[s] and generate[s] request code', suggesting UI actions map to API calls, plus a monitoring dashboard for browser-pool visibility. However, there is no discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe shows 404s), so it's unclear whether all UI-exposed capabilities (e.g., dashboard metrics) are fully API-accessible with parity guarantees. Missing for 10: published OpenAPI/API reference confirming full UI-feature coverage, explicit documentation stating UI and API have identical capability sets, and independent confirmation that dashboard-only features (metrics, browser pool visibility) are also API-retrievable.
